name: Sophistry
source:
In Sophistry, you live this drama the way you want! You want to see it from the eyes of the lead character, so be it, what about from the eyes of the second lead or even the antagonist? What do I say; you can even play it from the point of view of the love interest!

What about romances?

With 6 playable characters and each with 3 potential love interests, that’s a base of 18 full romances stories and plot lines!
